content.text: Kâyue kâoun laihoi im dawk yikkawi e pawitonae bu hlakvah
karoumcalah lahoi bukaro kam touh ca e ahawihnawn.
A lungkaang e san ni yeirai ka phawt e capa hah a uk teh,
hmaunawnghanaw hoi cungtalah râw a coe han.
Ngun sôlêi nahanelah manang, sui sôlêi nahanelah takhuenhmai,
hatei BAWIPA ni lungthin a tanouk.
Thoenae kasaknaw ni teh laithoe dueng a thai ngai awh teh,
laithoe kadeinaw ni hai laithoe lawk a thai ngai awh.
Tamimathoe ka dudam e ni kasakkung a dudam teh,
ayânaw runae a kâhmo navah
a lungkahawi e tami hai hlout mahoeh.
Mincanaw teh matawngnaw e bawilukhung doeh,
camonaw bawilennae teh a napanaw doeh.
Lawkkanem hoi tamipathu kamcu hoeh,
laithoe deinae pahni teh bawi hoi hoe kamcu hoeh.
Tadawnghno teh ka dâw e tami koe talung phukaawm hoi a kâvan,
a kangvawi tangkuem koe hawinae a hmu.
Lawkeknae ka ramuk pouh e ni lungpatawnae a tawng,
hatei boutbout ka dei pouh e tami ni teh huiko a kapek.
Tamipathu avai cum touh hem e hlak
tamilungkaang vai touh yue e aphuohnawn.
Tamikahawihoeh ni kâtaran nahane dueng doeh a tawng,
hatdawkvah patoune kathout hoi a kâhmo han.
Tamipathu a pathu lahun nah kâhmo e hlak teh,
a ca kahmat e tavom hoi kâhmo pawiteh bet ahawihnawn.
Hawinae hah thoenae hoi ka pathung e tami teh
hnokathout ni a imthung tâcawt takhai mahoeh.
Kâyuenae teh tuiim dawk hoi tui ka yu e patetlah ao,
hatdawkvah kâyue hoehnahlan kâounnae hah roun lawih.
Tamikayon a yon ka ngaithoum e tami hoi,
tamikalan yon kapen e tami hah BAWIPA ni a panuet
Tamipathu ni lungangnae a ngai hoeh dawkvah,
lungangnae ran nahane hnopai hah
bangkongmaw ahni kut dawk poe han vaw.
Hui ni teh nâtuek hai lung na pataw teh,
hmaunawngha teh runae kâhmo tueng nahanelah doeh a khe.
Thaipanueknae ka tawn hoeh e niteh
kuttabei kâtambei hoi a hui hmalah lawk a kam.
Lawkeknae ka ngai e ni teh kâyuenae hai a ngai,
a longkha ka rasangsak e ni rawknae hah a tawng.
Dumyennae lungthin ka tawn e ni hnokahawi hmawt mahoeh,
laithoe ka dei e tami teh runae hoi a kâhmo han.
Tamipathu ka khe e tami teh amahoima a lungmathoe sak,
ka pathu e capa ka tawn e tami teh konawmnae tawn hoeh.
Lungthin konawm e heh kahawipoung e tâsi hoi a kâvan teh,
lungthin reknae ni hru a ke sak.
Tamikathout ni lannae lamthung phen hanelah
a hnukkhu lahoi hno ouk a lawp.
Lungangnae teh thaipanueknae katawnkung hmalah ao teh,
tamipathu e mit ni teh talai pout totouh ouk a khet.
Capa pathu e teh na pa lung kamathoutsakkung lah ao teh,
kakhekung manu hanelah hai ka khat poung e lah ao.
Tamikalan rek hanelah awm hoeh,
ka talue e hai a hawi nahlangva hem hanelah awm hoeh.
Panuenae ka tawn e ni lawk a kâsum teh,
thaipanueknae ka tawn e teh roumnae muitha ka tawn e doeh.
Tamipathu hai duem awm pawiteh,
tamilungkaang patetlah pouk e lah ao,
a pahnicakuep pawiteh thaipanueknae ka tawn patetlah pouk e lah ao.
